metaTitle: Anime Cabinet How It Works | Custom Anime Portraits
description: See how Anime Cabinet creates hand-drawn custom anime portraits from your photos, with a preview within 72 hours, unlimited free revisions, and 24 styles.

bodySections.heading: What is Anime Cabinet?
paragraphs: Anime Cabinet is a custom portrait commission service where human artists turn your photo and ideas into an original anime or cartoon-inspired character. Unlike an AI filter, every portrait is hand-drawn by an artist who considers your pose, expression, clothing, colors, and requested theme. Our fan-art inspired styles use a visual language you recognize while presenting you, your family, friends, pets, or characters as original creations—not copyrighted character impersonations.

Choose from 24 anime and cartoon styles, including popular directions inspired by [Naruto](/portraits/naruto), [One Piece](/portraits/one-piece), [Dragon Ball Z](/portraits/dragon-ball-z), [Demon Slayer](/portraits/demon-slayer), and more. A custom anime portrait can be ordered as digital artwork or selected as a custom anime portrait canvas where available.

bodySections.heading: How the custom portrait process works
paragraphs: 1. **Choose your style and product.** Browse the available themes and select the portrait format, number of people, and options that suit your idea. Whether you want a custom anime portrait from photo, a gift, or a character concept, start with the style that best matches your vision.

2. **Send your details.** Upload clear reference photos and describe the result you want. Helpful information includes the subject’s name, preferred pose or expression, clothing, hairstyle, background, colors, accessories, and any important likeness details. You can also explain the mood or story behind the artwork. For a custom anime portrait Naruto-inspired request, for example, tell us which ninja-themed visual direction, outfit details, and original-character traits you prefer.

3. **A human artist draws your artwork.** Your references guide the commission, but the finished piece is an original hand-drawn interpretation. Artists adapt recognizable style elements without copying a copyrighted character or pretending that you are that character.
4. **Review your preview.** You receive an initial preview within 72 hours under standard delivery. Take your time checking the likeness, composition, colors, and requested details.

5. **Request revisions and approve.** Unlimited free revisions are included. Tell us what you would like changed, and your artist will refine the artwork until the direction feels right. Once approved, your final digital file or selected physical product is prepared for delivery.

bodySections.heading: What information does an artist need?
paragraphs: The best references are well-lit, high-resolution photos showing the face clearly. Send more than one angle when possible, especially for group portraits or distinctive hairstyles. Include specific instructions rather than relying on a broad request: mention the desired style, pose, outfit, background, colors, props, and whether you want a close-up or full-body composition. If you are unsure, share your inspiration and our artist can work from there.

bodySections.heading: Timing, cost, and ordering
paragraphs: To order through Anime Cabinet, select a style, upload your references, add your instructions, and complete checkout. The current price is displayed for your chosen options before you place the order; cost can vary by format, number of subjects, and product selection. Standard customers receive a preview within 72 hours, while any available faster option will be shown during ordering. The total commission time depends on revisions and product fulfillment, so the preview is the clearest first milestone.
Ready to begin? Explore a [custom anime portrait](/portraits/naruto) style, upload your photo, and let a human artist turn your idea into an original piece.

bodySections.heading: Frequently asked questions
paragraphs: **How does an anime cabinet work for creating custom anime portraits?** You choose a style, submit photos and instructions, review a hand-drawn preview within 72 hours, and use unlimited free revisions before approval.

**Can Anime Cabinet turn a photo into a personalized anime-style portrait?** Yes. Artists use your photo as a reference for likeness, pose, and details while creating a new anime or cartoon-inspired character.

**How long does an Anime Cabinet custom portrait commission usually take?** The first preview arrives within 72 hours under standard delivery. Final timing depends on revisions and whether you order a digital portrait or a physical product.

**What styles are available?** Anime Cabinet offers 24 anime and cartoon styles, including fan-art inspired directions such as Naruto, One Piece, Ghibli, and Dragon Ball Z. These are original interpretations, not replicas of copyrighted characters.
